| ID | Result |
|---|---|
| R8-1 red/green | With the old (`28ad3ab`) `metadata.ts`, exactly (a), (c1) and (d) fail; 3 failed, 8 passed out of 11. On the real tree all 11 pass. A's red log shows the same. The count is 11, not 10, because A added a seventh test, (f), which checks that the bad field reads back as empty. |
| R8-2 mutations | All five mutations were caught, and all five still type-check. M1, M2 and M4 make (a), (c1) and (d) fail; M2 fails on the "file bytes unchanged" check. M3 makes only (d) fail and M5 only (b). |
| R8-3 gate | The full verify command from a clean state exits 0: Biome 0 errors, 9 warnings, all in renderer files, none in `metadata.ts` before or after. Typecheck 0 errors, renderer 107/107, main 62/62 (55 + 7), E2E 7/7, also 7/7 with `--retries=0`. |
| R8-4 single save, bad schema (real app) | The Bad field appears in the panel and starts empty. After the fix, saving shows the toast `Error invoking remote method 'meta:write': Error: Failed to write metadata: RIFF INFO fields could not be written: AB`. The file's sha256 is unchanged and the row stays untagged after Rescan. |
| R8-4 before the fix | On a build with the `28ad3ab` `metadata.ts` the same save says `Tags saved`. The file gets `ICAT=DOORWood` and no `AB` field, so the field is silently dropped. The planner's inference is now confirmed in the real app. |
| R8-5 batch save (real app) | (i) Changing only Category gives `Tags saved to 2 files`. Both files have `ICAT=BATCHCat` (8 bytes, no NUL byte), and the raw bytes, ffprobe and music-metadata agree. (ii) Also changing Bad gives `0 saved, 2 failed`, and both files' sha256 are unchanged. On the old build, (ii) saved both files without `AB`. |
| R8-6 default schema (real app) | `Tags saved`. The file has `ICMT`/`IKEY`/`ICAT` of 10/10/8 bytes with no NUL byte; ffprobe and music-metadata agree. The row shows `Tagged` after Rescan. |
| R8-7 ownership and docs | Only the three owned files changed. `grep '//'` on `metadata.ts` finds nothing, and there are no `any`, `@ts-*`, `biome-ignore` or new comments. The docs diff only adds the new Georgian section, and it covers all five required points. |

The settings folder the app reads `schema.json` from is `<XDG_CONFIG_HOME>/Electron`, not "Czaba Tag Manager", because I launched the built `out/main/index.js` directly.

Two observations I didn't count as bugs:
- **4-byte IDs:** the docs say a `riffChunkId` must be "4 bytes (4 ASCII characters)", but the library only counts JavaScript characters. A 4-character non-ASCII ID would therefore not trigger the new error. This falls under the existing load-time validation signal B-R7-02.
- **Batch panel after a failed save:** both files' fields show the "Multiple values" placeholder. That is renderer behaviour, outside this round's scope, and I didn't look into it further.
